result.instructions: Tools for Urbanise Strata, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which plans do we manage, and who is the manager for each one?"; "Show the levy ledger for lot 12 in plan PS123456 since 1 July."; "List the unpaid receivable invoices for plan PS123456.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Urbanise Strata data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run urbanise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run urbanise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run urbanise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. urbanise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: urbanise_get_manager
tools.title: Get plan manager
tools.description: Get the strata manager details for one plan. Urbanise API: GET /manager/client/{clientId}/planNo/{planNo}.

planNo.description: Plan (strata scheme) number, for example "PS123456" or the number shown in Urbanise.

sortField.description: Field to sort by, as the API names it.

addressId.description: Owner address id to filter by.
